name: smartdraftboard
description: Fantasy roster analysis and projections for NFL, NBA, FPL, Fantrax EPL/NBA, AFL and NRL.

interface.longDescription: Compare fantasy players, analyze pasted rosters or public Sleeper leagues, and inspect available model backtests for NFL, NBA, FPL, Fantrax EPL/NBA, AFL and NRL. Read-only tools report scoring-specific projections, original source dates, uncertainty and missing-data warnings. When advertised, the NBA daily streaming planner compares supplied add/drop candidates by usable starts and net projected points. Recommendations depend on supported scoring and sufficient evidence. Link your SmartDraftBoard account to read your owned saved leagues on Free. Full roster optimisation and roster-aware trade analysis require Pro even for pasted rosters or public Sleeper leagues. Pro also covers advanced streaming and saved weekly/trade decisions. The integration cannot change lineups, submit trades or place bets.
defaultPrompt: Compare Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes for my NFL PPR lineup.
With Pro, analyze my FPL squad and suggest a legal starting formation.
Show the top 10 NBA guards in ESPN points scoring.

positive.prompt: Compare Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes in NFL PPR. Include data dates, sources and uncertainty.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve both players, report supported projections and uncertainty, and disclose missing data.

positive.prompt: Analyze my NFL PPR roster: Josh Allen, Bijan Robinson, Jahmyr Gibbs, CeeDee Lamb, Ja’Marr Chase, Brock Bowers.
positive.expected_behavior: Require a linked account and current Pro before reading or calculating roster decisions. For eligible Pro users, build a legal suggested lineup, identify empty seats and gaps, and make no league changes. Otherwise show the account-link or upgrade step without computing a decision.

positive.prompt: Show the top 10 NBA point guards in ESPN points scoring.
positive.expected_behavior: Use sport nba, scoring espn_points and PG; show dated rankings with attribution.

positive.prompt: Find Erling Haaland in your FPL player data and show his outlook.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve identity and provide FPL outlook, actual fixtures and availability; disclose unavailable predictions.

positive.prompt: Show the available FPL model accuracy and explain what the measured error means.
positive.expected_behavior: Read stored backtest evidence, explain its date and limitations, and report unavailable evidence honestly.

positive.prompt: Find Josh Alen BUF in the NFL data. Confirm who this is before comparing him with Patrick Mahomes in PPR.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with the sport and team hint; label a spelling suggestion and obtain confirmation before comparison. Do not infer identity from projected value.

positive.prompt: Compare Jalen Brunson and Stephen Curry in NBA ESPN points, with the source dates and projection period.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_players directly with sport nba and scoring espn_points. Only search if identity needs clarification. Preserve missing-data limits.

positive.prompt: Compare Erling Haaland and Bukayo Saka for Fantrax EPL using the complete scoring settings I provide.
positive.expected_behavior: Obtain complete scoring if missing. Set platform fantrax, pass the fantrax settings object and omit scoring; never send scoring=fantrax or substitute FPL.

negative.prompt: Write a birthday poem for my sister.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke SmartDraftBoard tools for an unrelated writing task.

negative.prompt: Submit a trade of Josh Allen for Patrick Mahomes in my Sleeper league now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration is read-only and cannot submit trades; offer analysis only.

negative.prompt: Place a $100 bet on tonight’s NBA game and tell me a guaranteed winning wager.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not place bets, promise wins or use fantasy forecasts as wagering advice.

review.commerce_description: Public player research, value-only trade comparisons and enabled saved-league fact reads are Free. Full roster optimisation, roster-aware trades and NBA streaming require current Pro, including pasted or public Sleeper inputs. One website membership also covers MCP; MCP does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.9.0 improves player discovery with source aliases, initials, team hints and labelled spelling suggestions. Adds structured correction and retry guidance, clearer Fantrax arguments, and shared Claude/ChatGPT workflow examples. Requires the matching MCP service deployment; read-only scopes and Free/Pro boundaries are unchanged.
